obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your tenancy account

results.segment: This letter confirms your appointment about your tenancy account with Ashcombe Housing Trust on 24 September 2026 at 10.40am.
Please arrive ten minutes early and bring this letter with you.
If you can no longer attend, our reception team will be glad to offer the time to somebody else.
The team responsible has been asked to reply to you within 5 days.
